description: Press the iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch Ultra Action Button once. The press is dispatched without activating the session app and nothing is re-observed afterwards, so the app keeps the state the press found. What the system does with the press is not observed by this command: Simulators run no Shortcuts or App Intents, so delivery to an assigned Shortcut is verifiable only on a physical iPhone. A model with no Action Button refuses with UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION, error.details.reason hardware_control_unavailable and dispatched: no. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.
